title: worked/got/went etc. (past simple)
summary: Past simple — действие, которое **закончилось в прошлом**: правильные глаголы + **-ed** (worked), неправильные имеют особую форму (went, saw).
ru:
## Когда используем
Past simple — это законченное действие в прошлом: **вчера, на прошлой неделе, в 2019 году, три дня назад**.
> I **cleaned** my teeth this morning. — Сегодня утром я почистил зубы.
> We **enjoyed** the party last night. — Вчера вечером нам понравилась вечеринка.
> Terry **worked** in a bank from 1986 to 1993. — Терри работал в банке с 1986 по 1993.
Форма одна для **всех лиц**: I / he / she / we / they **worked**. Никакого -s.

## Правильные глаголы: + -ed
> work → work**ed**, stay → stay**ed**, clean → clean**ed**
> arrive → arriv**ed** (на -e: просто + d), dance → danc**ed**

## Правила написания
- Согласная + **y** → **-ied**: try → tried, study → studied, copy → copied
- Одна гласная + одна согласная в коротком слове → **удваиваем**: stop → stopped, plan → planned
- Гласная + y: просто + ed: play → played, stay → stayed

## Неправильные глаголы
У них особая форма — её нужно запомнить.
> go → **went**, get → **got**, see → **saw**, have → **had**, do → **did**
> make → **made**, take → **took**, come → **came**, buy → **bought**, eat → **ate**
> write → **wrote**, meet → **met**, speak → **spoke**, give → **gave**, leave → **left**
> I usually get up early, but this morning I **got** up at 9.30.
> Jim **came** into the room, **took** off his coat and **sat** down.

## Слова-подсказки
**yesterday, last night / week / year, ago, in 2015, when I was ...**

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I go to the cinema yesterday.~~ → I **went** to the cinema yesterday.
- ~~We worked-ed.~~ → We **worked**.
- ~~She studyed.~~ → She **studied**.
- ~~He goed home.~~ → He **went** home.
- ~~I stoped.~~ → I **stopped**.
en:
## When do we use it?
We use the past simple for **finished actions in the past**: yesterday, last week, in 2019, three days ago.
> I **cleaned** my teeth this morning.
> We **enjoyed** the party last night.
> Terry **worked** in a bank from 1986 to 1993.
The form is the same for **all subjects**: I / he / she / we / they **worked**. No -s.

## Regular verbs: + -ed
> work → work**ed**, stay → stay**ed**, clean → clean**ed**
> arrive → arriv**ed** (ends in -e: just + d), dance → danc**ed**

## Spelling
- Consonant + **y** → **-ied**: try → tried, study → studied, copy → copied
- Short word, one vowel + one consonant → **double** the consonant: stop → stopped, plan → planned
- Vowel + y: just + ed: play → played, stay → stayed

## Irregular verbs
These have special past forms. You have to learn them.
> go → **went**, get → **got**, see → **saw**, have → **had**, do → **did**
> make → **made**, take → **took**, come → **came**, buy → **bought**, eat → **ate**
> write → **wrote**, meet → **met**, speak → **spoke**, give → **gave**, leave → **left**

## Time words
**yesterday, last night / week / year, ago, in 2015, when I was ...**

## Common mistakes
- ~~I go to the cinema yesterday.~~ → I **went** to the cinema yesterday.
- ~~She studyed.~~ → She **studied**.
- ~~He goed home.~~ → He **went** home.
structure:
## Правильные глаголы
| Правило | Present | Past |
|---|---|---|
| + ed | work, clean, start | worked, cleaned, started |
| на -e: + d | arrive, dance, like | arrived, danced, liked |
| согласная + y → ied | try, study, copy | tried, studied, copied |
| удвоение согласной | stop, plan, shop | stopped, planned, shopped |
| гласная + y: + ed | play, stay, enjoy | played, stayed, enjoyed |

## Часто встречающиеся неправильные глаголы
| Present | Past | Present | Past |
|---|---|---|---|
| go | went | buy | bought |
| get | got | eat | ate |
| see | saw | drink | drank |
| have | had | write | wrote |
| do | did | meet | met |
| make | made | speak | spoke |
| take | took | give | gave |
| come | came | leave | left |
| read | read /red/ | think | thought |
| say | said | sit | sat |

## Формула
> Подлежащее + **глагол в прошедшей форме** (одинаковая для всех лиц)
> She **worked** late. · We **went** home. · They **saw** a film.

## Особенности
- **was / were** — прошедшее от be (см. unit 10).
- **read** пишется одинаково в present и past, но произносится /red/ в past.
- Отрицание и вопросы — в unit 12.

exercises.title: Правильные глаголы
exercises.instruction: Поставьте глагол в скобках в past simple.

items.text: I {{cleaned}} my teeth three times yesterday.
It was hot in the room, so I {{opened}} the window.
When I was a child, I {{wanted}} to be a doctor.
We {{stayed}} at a very nice hotel last year.
The bus {{stopped}} and I got off.

items.q: She ___ a lovely dress last week.
We ___ a good film on Sunday.
Как сказать «Я позвонила маме два дня назад»?
options: I phoned my mum two days ago.
I phone my mum two days ago.
I phones my mum two days ago.

answers: I got up at 7 o'clock yesterday.
I got up at seven o'clock yesterday.
Yesterday I got up at 7 o'clock.
Yesterday I got up at seven o'clock.
I got up at 7 yesterday.
Yesterday I got up at 7.

items.prompt: (we / see / a good film / last night)
answers: We saw a good film last night.
Last night we saw a good film.

items.prompt: (she / buy / a new bag / on Saturday)
answers: She bought a new bag on Saturday.
On Saturday she bought a new bag.
They arrived at the station early.

items.prompt: (Tom / write / a letter / to his friend)
answers: Tom wrote a letter to his friend.

items.prompt: (my parents / go / to the seaside / last summer)
answers: My parents went to the seaside last summer.
Last summer my parents went to the seaside.
We went to the cinema yesterday.
Yesterday we went to the cinema.
We went to the movies yesterday.
Yesterday we went to the movies.
She bought new shoes.
She bought some new shoes.
She bought a new pair of shoes.
I lost my keys.
He wrote a letter.
We met Tom in the street.
We met Tom on the street.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Напишите о своём вчерашнем дне, используя past simple. Проверьте по образцу.

items.sample: I got up at seven o'clock.
I ate bread and cheese and drank tea.
I went to the shop and to the park.

items.prompt: Что вы смотрели или читали вчера вечером?
items.sample: I watched a film in the evening.

items.prompt: Что вы купили на прошлой неделе?
items.sample: I bought a new jacket last week.
